statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-76151 is an out-of-bounds read in Qt 6 QtNetwork Cache-Control response header parsing (QNetworkAccessManager). Qt's advisory lists affected versions as Qt 6.0.0 through 6.8.8 and 6.9.0 through 6.11.1 only; see https://www.qt.io/blog/security-advisory-cve-2026-76151. The DHI rebuild of qtbase-opensource-src 5.15.15+dfsg-6+deb13u1 is Qt 5 and does not ship the Qt 6 code path.
